reason: ChatGPT session has GitHub/Drive/Gmail/Notion/Vercel connectors, but no direct callable T4H bridge credential or Supabase service role. Need durable backup execution path and tool registry so work never dead-ends when direct bridge is unavailable.
objective: Create permanent backup execution pathways and new tool wrappers for T4H agent sessions when direct bridge execution is blocked.
blocked_from_direct_execution: No bridge call tool exposed in this chat session
No Supabase service-role credential exposed in this chat session
No AWS/Lambda credential exposed in this chat session
No local Mac endpoint execution available from hosted chat
available_connectors_observed: GitHub: TML-4PM/the-pen visible with admin/maintain/pull/push/triage permissions
Stripe connector available but payments actions remain BLOCKED/GATED by policy

required_permanent_backup_tools.purpose: Write canonical JSON jobs into TML-4PM/the-pen/inbox using idempotency key and durable receipt expectations.
required_permanent_backup_tools.done_when: File exists in inbox and GitHub commit SHA is returned.

required_permanent_backup_tools.purpose: Search receipts/runtime and audit logs for matching idempotency key before claiming completion.
required_permanent_backup_tools.done_when: Receipt is read and validated, or absence is reported as PARTIAL.

required_permanent_backup_tools.purpose: Server-side authenticated bridge invocation wrapper so hosted LLMs never need raw creds.
required_permanent_backup_tools.security: No raw secrets returned to LLM. Allowlisted Lambda/tool names only.

required_permanent_backup_tools.purpose: Read-only Supabase REST fallback for registry, queue, audit and evidence inspection.
required_permanent_backup_tools.security: Anon or scoped read token only; no writes.

required_permanent_backup_tools.purpose: At session start, detect available tools/connectors, classify execution lane, and select fallback route.
required_permanent_backup_tools.done_when: Session has explicit lane: direct bridge, pen enqueue, connector-only, or read-only.

fallback_routing_rules: If direct bridge is available: invoke bridge with idempotency key and require runtime receipt.
If bridge is unavailable but GitHub is available: enqueue job to the-pen/inbox and return commit SHA as PARTIAL handoff evidence.
If GitHub is unavailable but Notion/Drive is available: create durable handoff document marked PARTIAL and instruct Pen sweeper to ingest when available.
If only chat is available: provide copy-ready JSON and mark PRETEND until external write occurs.
Never claim REAL unless runtime receipt, audit row, or verified output exists.

implementation_contract.rls: Strong RLS for any direct DB write surface. Hosted LLM route should use queue-only writes, not arbitrary SQL.
implementation_contract.archive_policy: Archive not delete. Destructive actions remain gated.

closure_definition: Backup toolchain spec committed to GitHub inbox
Permanent capability probe and routing wrappers added or issue created against correct repo
Audit/evidence row bound to registry object
No direct bridge/credential dependency remains in hosted chat sessions
